title: コーポレート・ロゴ（ラウンド）ver3
description: A rounded gothic from Logotype JP: Gen Jyuu Gothic (derived from Source Han Sans) with original kana. It makes a tight, logo-like heading. OFL-1.1 allows a later promotion into the bundled binaries (today this is an index only).
when_to_use: For an emphasis title in the shape of a company logo or a title logo, or for a channel name
ai_usage: OFL-1.1 のため実体同梱への昇格が可能（昇格はオーナー裁定）。現状は索引のみ。グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
